# Toolset `employer_negotiations`

Employer responses and invitations, mail templates.

**5 tools.** Mutations require an explicit `confirm=true` argument; `Auth` marks tools that need an hh.ru token.

| Tool | Operation | Auth | Confirm | Description |
| --- | --- | :---: | :---: | --- |
| `employer_get_manager_negotiations_statistics` | `GET /employers/{employer_id}/managers/{manager_id}/negotiations_statistics` | yes | – | Get responses/invitations statistics for one manager of the company. |
| `employer_get_negotiations_statistics` | `GET /employers/{employer_id}/negotiations_statistics` | yes | – | Get aggregated responses/invitations statistics for the whole company. |
| `employer_get_resume_negotiations_history` | `GET /resumes/{resume_id}/negotiations_history` | yes | – | Get the history of responses and invitations for the resume visible to the employer. |
| `employer_list_mail_templates` | `GET /employers/{employer_id}/mail_templates` | yes | – | List response templates available to the employer for replying to candidates (invite, rejection and others). |
| `employer_update_mail_template` | `PUT /employers/{employer_id}/mail_templates/{template_id}` | yes | yes | Edit the text of a response template: the new text goes into `body`, e.g. {"text": "..."}. Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
